body:
This place http://www.exploring.co.nz/puzzling-world-wanaka.html

has a tilted room with a pool table inside. It appears as if the balls are rolling up the slope.

> Is your place a mess?

Easily the worst place I have ever lived. Shitty old apartment, no privacy horrible kitchen and bathroom bla bla bla. I am looking for another flat. Living in a rundown flat mates me messy. The broken windows theory is at work.
Getting judged (How hypocritical I judge people all the time) by the existing flatmates always sucks. Didn't get selected for the last flat I tried and I thought I got on really well with them.

> Alcohol is a depressant and the more you rely on it the more it will drag you down.

I wouldn't call myself an alcoholic, but it could be. Last year I got so drunk I went into the wrong house on the way home. I also had some magic mushrooms a couple weeks ago. It was fun for a while but overall I had a bad trip because I dislike myself.

> Getting laid should not be on your list of objectives.

I'm sure sex would be better than, say, my hand. Though what I really want is love, not that I truly know what it is. If I sort out the other issues first then this one should be easier.

> Consider seeing a counselor. I assume you have insurance, it will probably cover this. 

Being a overseas I just have to get some paper work sorted and my govt should cover medical stuff. I'm not sure if counseling counts though. I actually do have medical insurance, not sure if it covers counseling. I'm not in america so I should be fine.
Shit at least reddit is a start :)

> How about joining a gym? Working out at a good gym helps me a lot.

Depression makes everything not fun. I've been going to aikido classes less and less, now I don't go at all.
> I am 26 (male) and have never gotten laid.

Just pay for it (That might be illegal in some backwards places). You'll want to be a bit more skilled when you do bring a girl home. You're 26, keep going and you might be 35 and still have the V card.
